name: byteorder-swapped
reason: byte order field stored as BIGE while every other field is little-endian

name: blocksize-1000
reason: block size 1000, not a power of two

name: inodesize-512
reason: inode size 512 differs from block size 1024

name: numags-3
reason: three allocation groups claimed, 1024 blocks fit in one

name: blocksperag-0
reason: zero bitmap blocks per allocation group

name: numblocks-huge
reason: block count 2^56, far beyond the image

name: blocksize-512
reason: block size 512 with shift 9 (inode size left at 1024)

name: root-ag-9
reason: root directory run in allocation group 9 of 1: superblock sane, volume unusable

name: root-not-inode
reason: root directory run points at block 1, the block bitmap (no inode magic there)
